assertions.description: AudioWorklet.port is a readonly IDL attribute: an accessor on AudioWorklet.prototype with a getter and no setter.
context.audioWorklet.port is a MessagePort before any addModule() call (WPT audioworklet-messageport).
Reading audioWorklet.port twice returns the same MessagePort object.
Each BaseAudioContext has its own AudioWorklet, so two contexts expose two distinct ports.
assertions.test: (()=>{const a=new OfflineAudioContext(1,128,48000).audioWorklet.port,b=new OfflineAudioContext(1,128,44100).audioWorklet.port;return a instanceof MessagePort&&b instanceof MessagePort&&a!==b;})()

assertions.description: Assigning to the readonly audioWorklet.port in strict mode throws (no own property is created).
Inside AudioWorkletGlobalScope, the global port is a MessagePort exposed through a getter-only accessor on AudioWorkletGlobalScope.prototype.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const c=new OfflineAudioContext(1,128,48000);const p=c.audioWorklet.port;if(!(p instanceof MessagePort))return false;const code="if(typeof port==='object'&&port){const d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(AudioWorkletGlobalScope.prototype,'port');port.postMessage({ok:port instanceof MessagePort&&globalThis.port===port&&!!(d&&d.get)&&!(d&&d.set)});}registerProcessor('cf-gs',class extends AudioWorkletProcessor{process(){return false}});";const r=new Promise(res=>{p.onmessage=e=>res(!!(e.data&&e.data.ok));setTimeout(()=>res(false),2000);});const u=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([code],{type:'text/javascript'}));await c.audioWorklet.addModule(u);URL.revokeObjectURL(u);const v=await r;p.close();return v;})()

assertions.description: The global-scope port can post during module evaluation, and a message sent on audioWorklet.port reaches the global scope and is echoed back (WPT audioworklet-messageport).
assertions.test: (async()=>{const c=new OfflineAudioContext(1,128,48000);const p=c.audioWorklet.port;if(!(p instanceof MessagePort))return false;const code="if(typeof port==='object'&&port){port.onmessage=e=>port.postMessage({echo:e.data});port.postMessage({type:'module-evaluation'});}registerProcessor('cf-echo',class extends AudioWorkletProcessor{process(){return false}});";const got=[];p.onmessage=e=>got.push(e.data);const u=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([code],{type:'text/javascript'}));await c.audioWorklet.addModule(u);URL.revokeObjectURL(u);p.postMessage('hello world');await new Promise(r=>{const t0=Date.now();(function w(){if(got.length>=2||Date.now()-t0>2000)r();else setTimeout(w,20);})();});p.close();return got.some(d=>d&&d.type==='module-evaluation')&&got.some(d=>d&&d.echo==='hello world');})()
